description: A Layer of Late Victorian London: The Building Footprints from the 1:1,056 Ordnance Survey Map (1891–1896) is a data set described in the paper "A Layer of Late Victorian London: The Building Footprints from the 1:1,056 Ordnance Survey Map (1891–1896)" in Journal of Open Humanities Data (Ubiquity Press, 2026), produced by Remi Petitpierre, Isabella di Lenardo, Polly Hudson and colleagues. The abstract could not be read from the open sources used, so the contents are taken from the title. Coverage: London from the 1:1,056 Ordnance Survey map of 1891 to 1896. The data are held at the linked repository, and the catalogue links the data set first and the paper second; nothing was downloaded, so the file formats and size are not checked. Licence: not stated (data set page not opened on 2026-10-01). Cost: no charge is stated in the metadata read; the paper's own access terms were not checked. Caveats: written from the paper's title and metadata only, so contents, quality and current availability are unchecked and the description may lag the source. It can support historical building stock and urban change analysis. Related: the paper is the Journal of Open Humanities Data article 10.5334/johd.602.
